pay_detail: $4,995 per session (includes tuition, housing, meals, field trips, workshops and activities). Financial assistance is explained on the program policies page.
duration: Two weeks, residential. Session I: July 5 to 16, 2027. Session II: July 18 to 30, 2027.
name: Frontiers Summer Program
what_you_do: Live on the WPI campus for two weeks. Pick a STEM or business major and a minor in humanities, arts or business. You also get college prep workshops, trips and social events.
who_can_apply: Rising 10th, 11th and 12th graders. International applicants need an English test (TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo).
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open in early December. The page does not state the year or a close date.
how_to_apply: Application is free. It has two short written answers and a list of involvements. Official transcripts are preferred, but self-submitted ones are accepted. Questions: pop@wpi.edu or 508-831-4900.
notes: Costs money. The exact opening day in December is not stated. Ask about financial assistance on the program policies page.
